entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NU1903 warning reported incorrectly for multi-targeted builds #50843
  • build.cmd spawns a bunch of cmd window processes, stealing focus #50835
  • Incompatibility with .NET SDK 9.0.304 and 10.0.100-rc.1-25451.107 #50834
  • `dotnet project convert` should fix up relative paths in `#:project` references #50832
    10.0.1xx
  • Javascript collocation with dot separated files #50840
  • `dotnet list reference` command is not working in .NET 10 RC1. Returns Invalid project. The project file could not be loaded. Could not find a part of the path. #50830
    10.0.1xx
  • [WebToolsE2E][Hot Reload] Page does not update StyleSheet file when running .NET 10.0 blazor web app with SDK 10.0 RC 2 in CLI. #50829
  • [10.0-rc.1] dotnet run no longer accepts Windows path separators on Linux #50828
    10.0.1xx

Closed

  • Unable to find package Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64 with version (= 8.0.19) #50043
  • Dotnet 10.0.0-preview.7 is failing when --verbosity detailed is added to dotnet search or list command #50564
  • Consider adding `dotnet update` #50343
  • [NETSDKE2E] .NET 10 RC1 SDK from VS was not found after upgrade custom .NET 10 RC2 SDK #50725
  • Missing /usr/bin/dnx symlink after .NET SDK installation on Linux #50815
  • [WebToolsE2E] dotnet run of razor app with Release configuration fails with error: "ETag header not found..." #50656
  • about version #50825
  • Support -e (--environment) in dotnet test for MTP #50806
  • [WebToolsE2E]Create web Individual project failed with error “error NU1102: Unable to find package Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp... with version ... ” after installing SDK 10.0 RC2 #50697
  • [AspireE2E] When running a project with dotnet watch, pressing Ctrl+R to restart the project fails. #50817
  • [AspireE2E] When we click the "Stop" or "Restart" button on the Aspire dashboard after running the Aspire Starter App with dotnet watch, it fails. #50818
